examples.arabic: عمره بحياته ما دخل المطبخ إلا ليشرب كاسة مي أو يسرق حبة فاكهة.
examples.english: He had never entered the kitchen in his life except to drink a glass of water or steal a piece of fruit.
examples.transliteration: 'Omro bi hayaato ma dakhal il-matbakh illa layishrab kaaset mayy aw yisreq habbet faakiha.

examples.arabic: بس البراد مو بارد والفاكهة صارت دافية
examples.english: But the fridge is not cold and the fruit became warm.
examples.transliteration: Bas el barrad moo bared wel fakha saarat dafiyeh.
